blocks.text: Zscaler ITDR seamlessly integrates with third-party IT Service Management (ITSM) tools, such as ServiceNow, to track and assess posture and change issues. ITSM integration provides real-time visibility into issues, enabling organizations to take immediate action.
ITSM integration provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Assign the incident to appropriate teams or individuals.

blocks.text: On the Configurations page (ITDR > Integrations > Configurations), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View the list of available ITSM integrations. For each ITSM tool, you can view:
Enabled: If the integration is enabled or disabled. The X icon indicates that the integration is disabled, and the check mark icon indicates that the integration is enabled.
Configure or edit the ITSM integration.
